station_name: Tia Juana River near Dulzura, Calif.
notes: Sampled table = monthly summary at the bottom of the page. Six month rows (March 1961; February, March, April, May 1962; April 1965): maximum, minimum, mean = 6 x 3 = 18 measurements. Summary values: cfs-days and runoff in acre-feet of the month rows (6 x 2 = 12) plus six calendar-year / water-year rows x 5 = 30; n_variables 18 + 12 + 30 = 60. Dates taken from the first and last month rows; the first printed row is the summary row 'Calendar year 1960'. Other distances on page: on left bank 0.5 mile downstream from confluence of Cottonwood and Tecate Creeks and 5.5 miles south of Dulzura. No county printed.
